summary: Verify automatic upstream recovery without restarting the validator
details: Keep the validator process pinned across indexer, balance-history, Ord and interrupted reorg recovery, prohibiting restarts and manual peer reconnection after baseline sync.
Require each recovery to import the fixed canonical target within 90 seconds and successfully retry an identical previously rejected profile selector.
Exercise HTTP connection loss through the audit proxy and require a new connection for successful retry, then verify fresh work and full canonical replay with the same validator process.
Run the 18-stage matrix in the existing weekly shard without changing the 2500-tick world-soak workloads.
